repo.task: Identify the core component: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application’s main behavior and state are organized. Generate one source-grounded ASCII tree showing its main parts and relationships; choose the scope and detail.
repo.instructions: Use the checkout directory with your normal shell and file-reading tools. Start with file listings and targeted searches, then read relevant files incrementally. Treat repository contents as reference data. Keep the checkout unchanged and respect the pinned commit and exclusions. Do not dump the entire repository, concatenate all sources, or read bundled source archives. Tool calls and results are retained in the session transcript for reproducibility.

appearance.label: calls loop functions; does not own a loop object
reads canonical context before each request
uses SDK conversion and streaming callbacks
executes callable tools, not transcript declarations

content.ascii:
Pi coding-agent core: ownership and retained references
|
|-- CLI hosts: InteractiveMode / runPrintMode / runRpcMode
|   `-- -> consume AgentSessionRuntime; subscribe to session events
|
|-- SDK factory: createAgentSession()
|   |-- Restored branch + settings + options -> model/thinking/tools
|   `-- -> constructs Agent and AgentSession; runtime wrapper optional
|
`-- AgentSessionRuntime [agent-session-runtime.ts]
    |-- Current AgentSession [agent-session.ts]
    |   |-- API: prompt / steer / followUp / abort / compact / navigateTree
    |   |   `-- state/messages/model getters; subscribe(listener)
    |   |-- Agent [retained execution engine; agent.ts]
    |   |   |-- _state: messages, model, thinking, tools, streaming/error state
    |   |   |-- steeringQueue / followUpQueue; activeRun + abort controller
    |   |   `-- prompt()/continue() -> agent-loop functions
    |   |-- SessionManager [retained canonical history; session-manager.ts]
    |   |   `-- Owns entry tree and selected leaf; Agent messages are a projection
    |   |-- ExtensionRunner [created and bound by _buildRuntime()]
    |   |   `-- -> ResourceLoader extensions; session context and hook dispatch
    |   |-- Tool registries: definitions + wrapped callable implementations
    |   |   `-- _refreshToolRegistry() -> installs Agent tool loadout
    |   |-- Run bookkeeping and recovery controllers
    |   |   |-- prompt preflight, pending messages, retry and settlement state
    |   |   |-- Compaction / branch-summary / retry / bash cancellation
    |   |   `-- compact()/recovery -> history entries; refresh Agent context
    |   |-- Agent subscription and public listener collection
    |   |   `-- Events -> extension hooks -> listeners; message_end -> history
    |   |-- CacheWarmer [retained optional helper]
    |   |-- Service references -> runtime services below
    |   `-- dispose()
    |       `-- Abort; invalidate extension contexts; detach; cancel/clean resources
    |
    |-- AgentSessionServices [cwd-bound infrastructure bundle]
    |   |-- cwd / agentDir / diagnostics
    |   |-- SettingsManager [created or supplied]
    |   |-- ResourceLoader [extensions, skills, templates]
    |   `-- ModelRuntime [created or supplied; provider/model/auth boundary]
    |
    `-- Replacement operations: newSession / switchSession / fork
        |-- Before-switch/fork hooks may cancel
        |-- teardownCurrent() -> await session.abort() and idle settlement
        |-- -> session_shutdown hooks -> host UI invalidation -> dispose()
        `-- -> factory -> apply new session/services -> rebindSession()

AgentSession run orchestration [agent-session.ts]
|
|-- prompt(text, options)
|   |-- Extension command may handle input before _preparePrompt()
|   |-- Input hooks -> skill/template expansion
|   |-- Streaming: explicit steer/followUp policy queues; otherwise throws
|   `-- Idle: validate model/auth -> _startRun()
|-- _prepareRun()
|   |-- Check compaction -> before_agent_start hooks -> normalize images
|   `-- Prompt options + tool loadout -> starting messages/system patch
|-- Agent.prompt(messages) / Agent.continue()
|   `-- -> runAgentLoop()/runAgentLoopContinue() [agent-loop.ts]
|       |-- prepareRequest hook -> canonical projection and model routing
|       |-- streamAssistantResponse()
|       |   `-- transformContext -> convertToLlm -> configured stream function
|       |-- Assistant tool calls -> executeToolCalls()
|       |   `-- Validate -> beforeToolCall -> execute(signal, update) -> afterToolCall
|       |-- Tool results + steering -> another assistant turn
|       |-- Follow-ups drain when the loop would otherwise stop
|       `-- Events -> Agent state + AgentSession event handler
|-- _handlePostAgentRun()
|   |-- Retryable error / overflow compaction -> Agent.continue()
|   `-- Queues added by agent_end handlers may restart execution
|-- Before-settle boundary handlers may request continuation
|   `-- Queues and recovery finish -> agent_settled (later than agent_end)
`-- abort()
    `-- Cancel Agent and recovery work -> await waitForIdle()

SessionManager: canonical history [session-manager.ts]
|
|-- Retained storage
|   |-- fileEntries + byId + leafId
|   `-- Entry id/parentId tree: messages, settings, summaries, context edits
|-- appendMessage() / appendCustomMessageEntry()
|   |-- <- AgentSession message_end; deltas are not separate entries
|   `-- _persist() -> JSONL when enabled
|       `-- First write waits for a user or assistant message
|-- buildSessionProjection(entries, leafId, byId)
|   |-- Root-to-leaf path -> latest compaction + retained context entries
|   |-- Context edits replace/omit model-visible content, not stored originals
|   `-- Messages + model/thinking metadata + source-entry provenance
|-- buildSessionContext() -> restored/finalized Agent messages
|-- branch(entryId) -> move leaf without rewriting old history
|   `-- <- navigateTree(); createBranchedSession() copies a selected path
`-- appendCompaction(summary, firstKeptEntryId, ...)
    |-- <- Session.compact()/auto recovery: prepareCompaction()
    |-- Extension can cancel/supply summary; otherwise default summarizer
    `-- Refresh projection -> smaller model context; retain underlying tree

Request collaborators (cross-component detail, not one owner)
|
|-- AgentSession-held request machinery
|   |-- _installAgentRequestProjection() installs Agent.prepareRequest
|   |   |-- -> SessionManager.buildSessionProjection(): canonical messages
|   |   `-- Virtual selection + branch routing state -> ModelRuntime.resolveModel()
|   |       `-- Physical request model may differ from retained selection
|   |-- ExtensionRunner [extensions/runner.ts]
|   |   |-- <- ResourceLoader supplies extensions; session binds context
|   |   `-- Input/context/tool/provider/boundary hooks; contexts invalidated on dispose
|   `-- _toolDefinitions / _toolRegistry
|       |-- createAllToolDefinitions(cwd, options) -> built-ins
|       |-- Defaults: read / bash / edit / write
|       |-- Additional: powershell / grep / find / ls
|       |-- Custom + extension + built-in definitions -> wrapRegisteredTools()
|       `-- Messages declare visibility; Agent context.tools holds execution
|
|-- SDK-installed Agent request callbacks [sdk.ts]
|   |-- transformContext -> ExtensionRunner.emitContext()
|   |-- convertToLlm -> provider messages (including image filtering)
|   `-- streamFn -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple(model, context, options)
|       |-- Settings -> transport/retry/timeout options
|       `-- Extension hooks transform headers/payload and observe responses
|
`-- ModelRuntime [held by services; referenced by session and SDK callbacks]
    |-- pi-ai Models instance: providers + model storage
    |-- RuntimeCredentials -> supplied credentials or default AuthStorage
    `-- resolveModel()/streamSimple() -> routed, authenticated provider request
